title: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's birth chart
metaDescription: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 7.0° Aquarius. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Aquarius — the Sun, Mercury, Venus and Saturn. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At the noon reference the Sun sits 7.0° into Aquarius — the first decan, which the old scheme hands to Saturn. Same sign, different decan, different chart.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 7.5° Aquarius, Venus at 28.9° Aquarius, Mars at 0.4° Cancer. Mercury in a air sign reads as thought that travels by comparison; Venus in a air sign reads as attraction that begins as conversation; Mars in a water sign reads as effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts the Sun in the same degree of the zodiac from Mercury, 0.5° off exact. Two bodies in the same degree are not read as neighbours but as a merger: whatever one wants, the other is already funding. Behind it, Jupiter sextile Pluto at 0.7°, and Venus trine Mars at 1.5° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: No closed figure — no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross — holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks three placements here. The Sun in Aquarius at 7.0° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mars in Cancer at 0.4° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Saturn in Aquarius at 1.9° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The honest balance sheet uses the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: air 5, fire 3, water 2 across the elements, and fixed 5, mutable 3, cardinal 2 across the modalities. Air signs carry exchange in the scheme — comparison, argument, the sentence that makes the situation legible. No settled placement falls in earth — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Mars and Neptune were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Sagittarius for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.5° between midnight and midnight. The missing clock moves the Moon by half a sign at most here, and the boundary was never close. At the noon reference it stands at 12.8°.
